02 THE IDEA

One cell at a time.

Movers, pushers, rotators, and generators work together. Arrange them, press play, then tweak your design and try again.

03 CREDITS & CODE

CelLua Machine is a fan made game by KyYay, based on Cell Machine and the Mystic Mod. This web player runs the original LÖVE game package.
